# Vendored code

## `qf_transfer.py`

Verbatim copy of `quadforge/core/transfer.py` from
[nerdrx/quadforge](https://github.com/nerdrx/quadforge).

- Upstream commit: `f5e8e8e11bc0f72ab40f4bfb38ee59e520440572`
- Vendored: 2026-08-22
- Local modifications: **none**

Data preservation across a topology change — UVs (island-constrained),
materials, vertex groups, shape keys, creases and bevel weights, re-projected
by BVH barycentric lookup. It is a large, well-tested module that took a long
saga to get right (UV seam bleed, weight leaks under exact symmetry, crease arc
routing); re-deriving it here would be a mistake.

**Do not edit this file.** Fixes go upstream to QuadForge first, then the file
is re-copied and the commit above updated. Coupling is one argument: `apply()`
takes a settings object exposing `preserve_*` booleans, and `None` means
preserve everything.
